profile.headline: Software Engineer at Garmin International
profile.summary:
Senior software scientist and technical leader with over 30 years of product success.
 Creating robust, high performance products (in spite of hardware limitations) is fun.
 Successful full-cycle developer, whose excellent analytical skills contribute to all phases of product creation including customer analysis, product design, team leading / mentoring, detailed algorithm design, and programming / quality assurance / testing through to customer delivery / sign-off. 
  Exceptional handling varied functions, from software architect / developer to program manager to operations manager (IT, HR, purchasing, facilities, and security) for startups or small sites.

Specialties: Recent Software: C#; C++; C; .Net; JavaScript. Assemblers (various), Microcode/Firmware.
Recent Systems: Microsoft Windows (various), Apple Macintosh, Unix, Custom.
3D Rendering (DirectX D3D, OpenGL, Consoles, Real-Time Algorithms, Optimization).
Hardware/Software Tradeoffs (Size, Cost, Performance); Diagnostics; Device Drivers.
Operating Systems (Embedded, Real-Time, Fail-Safe, Multi-Processor/Processing/Tasking).

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designing, programming, creating handheld products. They do *hardware* here!

positions.title: Software Engineer (Sr. Staff), Site Operations Mgr
positions.description:
Lockheed Martin, Global Training and Logistics, Virtual World Labs (UltiSim, 3D Learning Solutions, merged from 3Dsolve).
VWL is the leader in GTL for reinventing how people prepare for their tomorrow via 3D computerized task training and simulation systems.
Full cycle developer successfully staying billable by creating/delivering multiple apps/demos to satisfied customers. (Sandtable (massive logistics), Landbased Nuclear (spatial planning), C130 (task training, emulation), Hospital (logistic analysis, simulation))
Senior software architect continually guiding and assisting our group in improving by identifying and implementing the latest best-of-breed development styles/methodologies.
Site COO: IT mgr, FSO, Facilities poc, Purchasing mgr, site process/procedures. (3DLS IT integration).

positions.title: Chief Scientist, Director of Process Management, Program Manager
positions.description:
3DSolve (http://3DSolve.com) is a full-service computer software development shop, comprised of the best developers from the Virtus family of companies. 
Founding member, creating the processes for Technical Development, IT, HR, and Facilities.
Successful program manager on our first multi-million dollar government contract (multi-year, 30 people).
Designed and implemented TRADOC's first "non-linear" level IV IMI course.
Created a pre-Blackberry system to view any websites, remote documents, or email attachments on your wireless PDA.

positions.title: Principal Software Technologist
positions.description:
Another Virtus spin-off, making a 3D CAD/Web MFC-based Shockwave tool.
Instrumental in creating a successful Studio 5.0 product release.
Increased reliability and robustness for their D3D/OpenGL renderer.
Lead architect for their next generation rendering system.

positions.title: Senior Scientist
positions.description:
Co-founded by Virtus and Michael Crichton, Timeline converts Crichton’s ideas into successful home game products. 
Founding member: instrumental in the startup and staffing of the Timeline business.
Core designer and developer of the initial Timeline prototypes and the ongoing mass market Timeline engine.
Doubled our product’s performance by creating our COM-based dynamic database system. 
Designed, directed, and successfully implemented the cross-platform porting of our real-time PC framework, 3D rendering system, and game components to the multi-processor PS2 console.

positions.title: Director of Applications / Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Virtus Corporation, founded in 1990, has provided real-time interactive 3D visualization tools to multimedia designers, architects, and movie set creators through shrink-wrap software for desktop computers. Its cross-platform component framework forms the core for several spun-off entertainment (Tom Clancy’s Red Storm, Michael Crichton’s Timeline) and business (NxView, 3dvillage) companies.
Designed, managed, and/or implemented over twenty products / SKU’s.
Successfully won, managed, and delivered on time many custom proposals / projects involving technical innovations on new hardware platforms.
Developed, adapted, and enhanced our software, D3D, and OpenGL renderers.
Patent manager, providing technical reviews and responses to the PTO. 
Created our mesh physics engine (FEM), used for simulating cloth, flags, confetti, and leaves.
Invented many rendering solutions, including rapid phong shading and various high speed texturing techniques.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Creating ASIC solutions to high-end computing needs, GE SSTD developed the Graphicon series of 3D image generators for use in FAA approved flight simulators.
Chief software architect for our high-end real-time embedded multi-processor/DSP system.
Doubled the performance and also reduced the hardware’s complexity for our custom real-time multi-processor system. (Hardware/Software Tradeoffs, Non-Locking Database Updates.)
Analyzed all software and hardware designs to improve system performance and stability.
Sole engineer for a critical 30,000 line client-server module. No customer detected bugs.
Active voting member on ANSI standards committee, creating and reviewing technical proposals.

positions.title: Senior Microprogrammer Engineer
positions.description:
Atari Coin-Op creates novel interactive entertainment on custom state-of-art hardware.
Created six successful embedded products, each on different custom state-of-art hardware. 
Invented the company’s major profit maker of 1983. (Star Wars arcade game.)

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Spectra created hospital patient care systems to eradicate transcription errors and improve care.
Eliminated our product’s 20% catastrophic crash rate. (Real-Time Memory Allocation/Protection.)
Designed an innovative method for keeping complete track of what our hospital system was doing. This allowed errors to be quickly located and fixed. (Event Recording, Re-entrant Disk Drivers.)
